E1.evidence:
The issue quotes the buildfarm test failure with file and line: "/tmp/ws/src/ros-perception/image_common/image_transport/test/test_qos_override.cpp:115
Expected equality of these values:
  endpoint_info_vec[0].qos_profile().reliability()
    Which is: 4-byte object <01-00 00-00>
  rclcpp::ReliabilityPolicy::BestEffort
    Which is: 4-byte object <02-00 00-00>" (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/issues/370); a second report: "This is happening not only on Zenoh, but it's also happening consistently on cyclone." (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/issues/370#issuecomment-3179270735); maintainer fix PR #376 "Fix QoS override tests" merged.

E2.interface_kind: library API (middleware resolution of SYSTEM_DEFAULT QoS reported through the graph-introspection API for a topic endpoint)
E2.evidence: The image_transport QoS-override test creates a subscription with rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS() and asserts that the middleware reports BestEffort reliability for it: "auto sub = image_transport::create_subscription(" ... "sub_node_.get(), "camera/image", fcn, "raw", rclcpp::SystemDefaultsQoS());" / "EXPECT_EQ(endpoint_info_vec[0].qos_profile().reliability()," / "rclcpp::ReliabilityPolicy::BestEffort);" (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/blob/b2abe1e5eaac06ba7af6ee110ff252076f2b95e6/image_transport/test/test_qos_override.cpp). rmw_zenoh_cpp resolves a SYSTEM_DEFAULT reliability to its own default: "#define RMW_ZENOH_DEFAULT_RELIABILITY RMW_QOS_POLICY_RELIABILITY_RELIABLE;" and "case RMW_QOS_POLICY_RELIABILITY_SYSTEM_DEFAULT:" ... "qos_profile->reliability = default_qos_.reliability;" (https://github.com/ros2/rmw_zenoh/blob/cdb66eed88a41775e4d6b7a3919805d4963f606b/rmw_zenoh_cpp/src/detail/qos.cpp). The rmw_zenoh maintainer who filed the linked report states the assumption crosses the boundary: "the RMW implementation can decide what the reliability should be if `SystemDefaultsQoS` is specified." (https://github.com/ros-perception/point_cloud_transport/issues/127). The failure depends on which middleware resolves the default (the same test only failed on the zenoh and cyclone nightly jobs), so it is not internal; the fix edits test assertions, not deployment names or the build.

E3.evidence: PAIR: the middleware's reported QoS of the test's subscription endpoint (output of rmw_zenoh_cpp via rclcpp get_subscriptions_info_by_topic) feeds the test's assertion (input of image_transport's test). Observed in the Rolling nightly job with rmw_zenoh: "Nightly test failure with rmw_zenoh" (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/issues/370).

E4.evidence:
Observed test failures on the buildfarm: "The tests that are failing are:
- image_transport.TestQosOverride.qos_override_subscriber_without_options
- image_transport.TestQosOverride.qos_override_subscriber_with_options
- projectroot.test_image_transport_qos_override" (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/issues/370#issuecomment-3228421916).

units.revision_basis: The failing nightly (Rci__nightly-zenoh_ubuntu_noble_amd64 #143, Jenkins record no longer available) built the rolling branch from source; the issue was filed 2025-08-08T17:04Z. The rolling head from 2025-07-25 to 2025-08-19 was b2abe1e5 (tag commit 6.3.0), and in that revision the two failing EXPECT_EQ statements sit exactly at the reported lines 115 and 123 of image_transport/test/test_qos_override.cpp. The test file is unchanged from fbb8b0b0 (2025-07-21) through b2abe1e5, so any rolling head in that window gives the same broken test. Resolved revision is the merge commit of PR #376 on rolling (2025-09-08).

units.name: rmw_zenoh_cpp
units.revision_basis: The reporter names only the Rolling nightly zenoh job. rmw_zenoh's rolling branch head from 2025-07-29 (0.8.2 release commit cdb66eed) until 2025-08-12 was cdb66eed; the build date of job #143 is not recoverable, so this is the head on the report date. rmw_zenoh_cpp/src/detail/qos.cpp (default reliability RELIABLE) is unchanged between 2025-03-11 and 2025-12-19, so any rolling revision in that window gives the same behaviour. The resolution does not change rmw_zenoh, so the resolved revision equals the broken one.

loudness_evidence: The mismatch is caught only by the test's own gtest assertion ("Expected equality of these values:" ... "rclcpp::ReliabilityPolicy::BestEffort", https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/issues/370); no middleware, connection, or QoS-incompatibility diagnostic is reported.

resolution.summary:
PR #376 stops asserting a specific resolved reliability for SystemDefaultsQoS subscriptions and only asserts it is known: "-  EXPECT_EQ(endpoint_info_vec[0].qos_profile().reliability(),
-    rclcpp::ReliabilityPolicy::BestEffort);
+  EXPECT_NE(endpoint_info_vec[0].qos_profile().reliability(),
+    rclcpp::ReliabilityPolicy::Unknown);" (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/pull/376/files). rmw_zenoh is unchanged.
resolution.evidence: A buildfarm maintainer later wrote "This is already fixed. We should close the issue" (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/issues/370#issuecomment-3486564849) without identifying the nightly run or the rmw_zenoh revision; the PR's own ci.ros2.org run (https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/pull/376#issuecomment-3258561938) does not identify an rmw_zenoh revision either.

notes: The defect is in the consumer's test assumption; the provider's behaviour is by design. The same failure is reported with rmw_cyclonedds_cpp as peer ("it's also happening consistently on cyclone", https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/issues/370#issuecomment-3179270735); that is the same consumer-side assumption against a different provider and is not specified here. A separate CycloneDDS-only failure ("image_transport.test_image_transport-qos_override.gtest.missing_result", https://github.com/ros-perception/image_common/issues/370#issuecomment-3242574095) is a different symptom and not a condition of this case. The test reaches rmw through rclcpp and rcl (rclcpp::Node::get_subscriptions_info_by_topic, image_transport::create_subscription); inventory elements name the rmw API symbols at the image_transport/rmw boundary because rclcpp and rcl only pass the values through. Fast DDS as peer: the source implies (nightly failures reported only for zenoh and cyclone) but does not state that the assertion holds with rmw_fastrtps. The class qos_reliability is used because the attribute whose resolved value crosses the boundary is the reliability policy; there is no publisher/subscriber incompatibility. The same pattern was fixed earlier in point_cloud_transport (PR #128) for issue #127. Operation alternatives: none observed besides PAIR.
